02

Kid colors (6)

One color per child, chosen at registration.Source is used only on the dot · border · avatar ring; the large-area Block bgcolor-mix(in srgb, source 15%, #FFFFFF) is auto-derived. Block text is always ink #1D1D1B.

Derivation rule
--kid-source: <자녀 색>;                                       /* dot, border, avatar ring */
--kid-bg:     color-mix(in srgb, var(--kid-source) 15%, #FFFFFF); /* block background */

Avatar ring — box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px var(--kid-source)(see the avatar cards above).

03

Typography

Korean & UI use Pretendard, Latin & numerals use Noto Sans, and monospace (time labels) uses Geist Mono. Weights 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 — only these four; 800/900 are logo-only exceptions.

Rules
  • Titles & section headers use --font-display(Paperlogy); body, list rows, child names and numbers use --font-text(Pretendard).
  • Paperlogy must be registered by its real name 'Paperlogy' —'Pretendard' registering it under that name would override the real Pretendard body font.
  • Weights 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 only.
  • 800/900 are exceptional (logo) assets.
  • letter-spacing is negative only at large sizes (20px+).
  • body line-height 1.45–1.50, titles 1.15–1.30.
04

Radius

6 steps + full. Avoid more than a two-step gap within one layer. Buttons & inputs are fixed at r-md (12); full is reserved for the FAB, avatars and status pills.

r-xs · 6 tag · micro
r-sm · 8 Schedule block
r-md · 12 button · input
r-lg · 16 card · sheet handle
r-xl · 24 bottom-sheet top
r-full · 9999 FAB · avatar · pill
05

Elevation

Cards use no drop shadow— the border (hair) handles containment. Shadows are only for the FAB, the primary-button focus, and sheet edges.

06

Icons

4 fixed categories (school · academy · activity · other); system icons use lucide-react-native mapping. The prototype uses app-tokens.jsx hand-drawn SVGs.

Buttons

5 variants (Ink · Primary · Ghost · Soft · Danger) × 2 radii(default r-md 12· option pill full). The main CTA is the Ink + Pill + Large combination — the app standard (onboarding “Start”, “Done”, etc.).

The Sunset Orange primary button appears only with brand intent(pickup card, emphasis action); otherwise Ink sets the hierarchy.

spec
  • bg— color-mix(child 15%, #FFFFFF) ·border 1px solid {kid.source} · radius 8.
  • title — Pretendard 12/500 ink (hidden when the block is small, icon only).
  • place — Pretendard 10/400 inkSub (2nd line truncates).
  • pickup dot— top-right 7px primary #FF7144+ 2px #fff ring (marks needs-pickup).
  • modify-exception dot— top-right 6px warning-dot #FFB000(info-level, different meaning).
  • Cancelled — opacity 0.3 + 1px horizontal strike-through.
  • sub-30-min slots render at proportional height (no clipping).
  • 픽업 충돌 is surfaced only as a grid sub-bar pill — never as a block overlay or OS push.

a modal that slides up. Top radius r-xl (24), grabber 38×4px; in-sheet buttons exceptionally use .btn--sheet (radius 14) to match the sheet's structure.

  • Container — bg #fff · radius 24 24 0 0 · padding 20 18 24
  • Grabber — 38×4 · radius full · ink-12 · margin 0 auto 16
  • Title — 17/700 Pretendard · letter-spacing -0.01em
  • Body — 13/400 · ink-sub · line-height 1.5
  • CTA— inside the sheet,.btn--sheet (radius 14) exception

19

Do · Don't

Summarizes the guidance in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §9.

Do
  • Sunset Orange is for brand emphasis(pickup · focus) only — general CTAs use Ink.
  • The FAB is Ink (black) by default — the Primary FAB is brand-intent only.
  • Main CTA is the Ink + Pill + Large combination (onboarding · sheet).
  • Run kid colors through the §3 derivation rule before use.
  • Grays use only ink opacity variants.
  • Pretendard weights 400/500/600/700 only.
  • Card containment uses the hair border.
  • general single actions use r-md (12), main CTAs are pills, in-sheet is 14.
  • Don't use danger and primary together in one area — their hues are distinct but read alike.
Don't
  • Don't place the 6 kid colors adjacent as a palette.
  • Don't pave every background in warm cream (no Lovable copy).
  • Don't use arbitrary gray hex (#999, #CCC).
  • Don't separate cards with shadows.
  • Don't include orange in the kid picker.
  • Don't set button radius to 99px (pill) — use 12 unless it's a FAB.
  • Don't show pickup conflicts as a push/overlay on the block.
End of System
